description: What a deployment would change, block by block, and what each block costs per month; the plan is kept for apply_plan.

from_state.description: Go back to a state version (number given by observe_app { view: "history" }): the plan says what to change to get it back; then apply_plan.

intent.description: Content of while.yaml; without it, the one in the latest commit at while (like deploy_app), otherwise the last one deployed.

plan_id.description: Reread this plan (computed earlier) instead of computing one.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: plan_deploy
title: Plan a deployment
